Rock Lamp

Sculptural lighting piece combining natural forms with integrated illumination | 2025

About

Rock Lamp is a sculptural lighting piece that merges natural stone forms with integrated LED illumination. The design explores the intersection of organic materials and modern technology, creating a functional art object that brings warmth and character to any space.

Design Process

The lamp features carefully selected natural stones that serve as both structural elements and aesthetic focal points. Each piece is hand-selected for its unique texture, color, and form, ensuring that no two lamps are exactly alike.

LED lighting is seamlessly integrated into the design, providing ambient illumination while highlighting the natural beauty of the stone. The lighting system is designed to be energy-efficient and long-lasting, with adjustable brightness to suit different moods and settings.

Materials & Construction

The lamp combines natural stone with precision-engineered components. The base incorporates the electrical system while maintaining a minimalist aesthetic that allows the stone to be the primary visual element.
